title: S&S PromoStandards service directory

title: ASI SmartLink product description

title: Supabase Postgres SSL enforcement
finding: Verified hostname and CA validation require the database CA certificate available in project Database settings. Changing server enforcement can restart the database.
engineeringDecision: Obtain the approved project certificate; keep TLS verification on. Do not change server enforcement to repair a client trust-chain error.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: Cloudflare Containers filesystem lifecycle
finding: Container disks are ephemeral by default. Sleeping and restarting uses a fresh image filesystem; snapshots are point-in-time, not continuous database durability.
engineeringDecision: Keep PostgreSQL authoritative outside the container and store artwork separately. Do not mount PostgreSQL data on an object-store FUSE filesystem.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: Cloudflare R2 bucket exposure
finding: R2 buckets require explicit action to become public. A public r2.dev route remains an alternative route even when a custom-domain Access policy exists.
engineeringDecision: Use a dedicated private bucket with public routes disabled and an authorized application asset endpoint. Provisioning remains a separate approval gate.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: Supabase Vault
finding: Vault encrypts stored secrets and exposes decrypted values through a SQL view; that view must be protected by SQL privileges.
engineeringDecision: Prefer a scoped server-only secret broker over broad access to decrypted_secrets. Test ACLs, rotation and restore before accepting real supplier secrets.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: Cloudflare Secrets Store access control
finding: Secret metadata read access differs from consumption/binding permission. Binding a secret needs Edit permission and an appropriate consuming-service scope.
engineeringDecision: Use platform secrets for deployment bootstrap; avoid granting an ordinary supplier setup form account-wide secret administration.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: Supabase backup coverage
finding: Database backups exclude Storage API object bytes; custom role passwords also require restoration handling.
engineeringDecision: Restore database records, object bytes, secret access and role credentials together in an isolated drill. A successful local database dump alone is insufficient.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: PostgreSQL row security
finding: RLS policies apply in addition to grants; owners and bypass roles need special attention, and permissive policies combine with OR.
engineeringDecision: Test the actual restricted runtime role for every exposed resource and operation, including composite relationships and security-definer functions.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: PostgreSQL concurrency control
finding: Read Committed does not serialize competing business decisions. Serializable transactions can require retries.
engineeringDecision: Lock budget and credit aggregates, enforce unique business keys, and retry only database-safe conflicts. Never blindly replay an ambiguous provider write.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: PostgreSQL exact numeric types
finding: Numeric supports exact decimal operations; floating-point types are inexact. Declared numeric scales can round stored values.
engineeringDecision: Retain supplier unit precision through extension; round at declared money boundaries and test tier edges, allocation residuals and aggregate totals.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: OWASP secrets lifecycle
finding: Secret controls include least privilege, revocation, rotation and preventing plaintext logging.
engineeringDecision: Replacement-only admin forms, opaque references, worker-only resolution, redacted diagnostics and rotation evidence are required.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: OWASP file upload defenses
finding: File defenses combine type checks, limits, isolated storage and appropriate scanning or content reconstruction.
engineeringDecision: Add persistent quarantine, scanner results and safe derivatives. Do not mark a magic-byte match as production-safe artwork.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: OWASP SSRF defenses
finding: Destination allowlisting must be combined with resolved-address and connection-time protections; domain checks alone do not stop rebinding.
engineeringDecision: Retain pinned public DNS, TLS validation, response bounds and redirect rejection for supported profiles, including retries and media ingestion.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: OWASP XML entity controls
finding: DTD/entity resolution and external resource loading require explicit hardening, including validation and transformation paths.
engineeringDecision: Expand nested XML mapping with bounded selectors and namespaces without allowing external entities, XInclude or remote schema fetches.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: OWASP spreadsheet formula injection
finding: Spreadsheet applications can interpret exported user values as formulas. Escaping behavior varies, including save/reopen behavior and locale variants.
engineeringDecision: Centralize export handling and test control characters, delimiters, Unicode and supported spreadsheet behavior; do not claim universal safety from a prefix regex.
accessNote: Primary documentation text reviewed; account-specific access is not established.

title: CIP4 job and process separation
finding: JDF/XJDF concepts distinguish product intent, process resources and operational feedback to an MIS.
engineeringDecision: Model separate materials, decorator operations, QC and actual costs. Use this as design guidance; a machine JDF adapter is not added to V1 scope.

title: Ghent Workgroup printing PDF guidance
finding: Print-file quality depends on issues such as fonts, color spaces, transparency and applicable specifications.
engineeringDecision: Separate visual approval from method-specific production-file review, with verified evidence for a released derivative.

title: Ghent Workgroup sign/display profile
finding: Large-format digital workflows have a dedicated specification rather than one universal PDF profile.
engineeringDecision: Store a versioned method/provider profile for zones, bleed, resolution and output requirements. Fixed generic DPI/bleed rules are not universal.

title: Stripe webhook delivery semantics
finding: Events can be repeated and delivered out of order; endpoint verification and event identifiers matter.
engineeringDecision: Use provider-specific signature validation, durable inbox records and current-object reconciliation. Stripe is a researched example, not an activated processor.

title: QuickBooks webhook recovery

engineeringDecision: Keep the external ledger authoritative, map company/realm and provider IDs, and reconcile references without duplicate ledger writes.

title: WCAG 2.2
